answer: Give every new agent a one-time onyx ticket drawn from the epoch beacon: the beacon publishes a random nebula of eligible slots, and an agent must present its ticket plus a 2,000-POA bond locked for 30 days before it can transact. Any peer may challenge a suspect identity within a 48-hour window; if a 5-of-7 randomly drawn jury finds the account is a duplicate, the bond is slashed and split among challengers. A Sybil farmer on a knoll of fake accounts must therefore pay 2,000 POA per fake plus the cost of forging a distinct ticket, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable bond.
